description: List the outside systems this organization has connected (Slack, Gmail, Linear, spreadsheets and so on) with the live state of each: active, still authorizing, failed, or disconnected. Each entry carries a plain explanation of what went wrong when something is not working. Use this whenever someone asks what is connected, why a connection is not working, or what you can currently reach. This is the source of truth about connections -- do not infer them from which tools you happen to have.
name: list_connections
